sourceBindings.claim: The notes endpoint obtains the caller identity from request.user; the source does not establish a concrete caller identity.
sourceBindings.reason: Source-visible identity binding at the requested entry.

sourceBindings.claim: The addressed document is selected by pk and loaded as doc; the same doc is passed to the permission checks and note effects.

rules.claim: The notes(request, pk=None) entry loads the addressed Document and then dispatches by HTTP method.

For the notes entry, when currentUser is not None and has_perms_owner_aware(currentUser, "view_document", doc) is false, the request is rejected with HttpResponseForbidden before method-specific effects.
On GET, the source returns serializer.to_representation(doc).get("notes"); the protected output is notes for the same doc.
On POST, when currentUser is not None and has_perms_owner_aware(currentUser, "change_document", doc) is false, the request is rejected with HttpResponseForbidden before Note.objects.create.
On POST after the change_document guard, Note.objects.create uses document=doc, note=request.data["note"], and user=currentUser; the created note is for the same addressed doc.
After POST note creation and update work, the source returns serializer.to_representation(doc).get("notes") for the same doc.

policyRules.text: Viewing notes requires a view_document grant for the addressed document
creating notes requires a change_document grant for that same document
Document ownership by itself does not substitute for either grant.
